title: Hooky

description.en: Send webhooks from your browser toolbar, context menu, or a quick message.
description.zh: 从浏览器工具栏、右键菜单或快捷消息中，随手触发 Webhook。

websiteSource: Chrome Web Store link in repository README.md at 8ebc6aa82c51ad0bed4b6684c1c12d9e7b2a3f5a
subject: Pink octopus

source.description: Chrome extension to trigger webhooks from toolbar, context menu, or Quick Send

subject.en: Original pink faceted octopus with curled arms
subject.zh: 保留原图的粉色碎片化章鱼与卷曲腕足

description.en: The head, expression, curled arms, and native spacing are unchanged. Every visible arm remains clear of the rounded boundary. The original foreground is preserved byte-for-byte.
description.zh: 头部、表情、腕足与原有留白保持不变。所有可见腕足都位于圆角边界之内，透明原图逐字节保留。

description.en: The pink-to-lilac planes and violet curls already belong to the family. Their existing motion supplies the character; this pass adds no accessory and makes no image-generation call.
description.zh: 粉色到丁香紫的色面与紫色卷曲腕足已经具备家族风格。原来的动态继续承担表情，这次没有新增配饰或调用生图。

description.en: Open hook-shaped channels enter a muted plum field from different edges. Fine grain, offset highlights, and low contact shadows keep the background tactile and the octopus prominent.
description.zh: 开口的卷曲沟纹从不同边缘进入柔和梅紫底色，细颗粒、偏移高光和轻浅阴影带来触感，同时突出章鱼主体。

sizeNote.en: At 32 px the pink head and violet curls carry the mark. At 16 px the small arm gaps and facets merge; toolbar and tab marks use the transparent source. Native source: 900 px; 1024/2048 px exports are upscales.
sizeNote.zh: 32 像素时粉色头部与紫色腕足形成清晰标识；16 像素时细小缝隙和碎片会合并。工具栏与标签页使用透明原图。原图为 900 像素，1024、2048 为放大导出。

goal.en: Send page URLs, titles, selections, and metadata to configured webhooks from Chrome, using a popup, context menu, or click-triggered rules.
goal.zh: 通过 Chrome 弹窗、右键菜单或点击触发的规则，将页面 URL、标题、选区和元数据发送到指定 Webhook。

role.zh: Service worker 与浏览器集成

description.en: Open curling channels approach from different directions, echoing the octopus’s arms without enclosing them.
description.zh: 开放的卷曲通道从不同方向靠近，呼应章鱼腕足，不围合、不缠绕主体。

alt.en: Original pink faceted octopus with curled arms on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 保留原图的粉色碎片化章鱼与卷曲腕足，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: Pink faceted octopus with curled arms.
description.zh: 粉色碎片化章鱼与卷曲腕足。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥64px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 64px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
